aria: Animated demo: an NFC tap on an ONDE product opens the Google review page

tap.title: Tap
tap.body: Your customer holds their phone near the ONDE product. No app, no scanning.

notification.title: Notification
notification.body: A notification drops in at the top of the screen. One touch: onde.tn sends them to your Google page.

review.title: Google review
review.body: Your business's Google review page opens — here, ONDE's own. Five stars, two lines, posted.

demoNote: Demo — ONDE's own Google review page as the example

viewer.keyboard: Use the left and right arrow keys to rotate the product

alt.stand-white: White ONDE Google review stand, clear acrylic bent into an L, 3D view
alt.stand-black: Black ONDE Google review stand, clear acrylic bent into an L, 3D view

hero.alt: White ONDE Google review stand in clear acrylic bent into an L, floating in a violet glow
